params.message:
Sources page: what is broken first, every source at a glance

Needs a look puts each failing source first, with its error, its streak and
Mute beside it. Adapters are one line each with a volume bar and a single
status. All sources are tiles grouped by adapter, filled by signals in 30
days, opening a side panel to change one. Adds a shared Button with hover,
focus and disabled states, and lets the header wrap on a phone.

Portal: De bronnenpagina van de Observatory toont eerst welke bron stuk is, met een knop om ze stil te zetten, en alle bronnen in één overzicht.
